Independent verification of repairs from verifier-review.json and verifier-revision-review.json: (1) Leaf schema paths and depths for ans-deep-001, ans-deep-002, ans-deep-003 corrected to depth 9 with leaf attributes (status, regex_values, name); (2) Corrected ans-deep-009 entity reference from non-existent xcsh_bot_defense_policy to canonical xcsh_bot_endpoint_policy data source; (3) Harmonized answerable timeout prompts (ans-std-015 to ans-std-022) so property duration attributes point to properties/timeouts/index.md#section while usage guidance points to lifecycle/timeouts/index.md#timeouts; (4) Replaced artificial timeout ambiguities amb-038 and amb-039 with genuine architectural ambiguities (application tenancy single vs multi app, and backend port routing mode); (5) Refactored all 40 ambiguous cases to concrete HCL requests requesting configuration drafting with unstated operational parameters, eliminating mechanical comparative (versus), toggle (between enabled and disabled), and schema-enumerating prompts; (6) amb-008 rewritten from single-destination data source lookup to genuine resource vs data source ambiguity with unstated origin/ownership; (7) amb-001 refined to request drafting private key block with missing secret storage representation (clear vs blindfold), eliminating tension with leaf destinations.

Control verification confirmed: 10 ordinary-discovery controls (ctrl-disc-001 to ctrl-disc-010) correctly test non-Terraform activation boundaries with empty expected destinations; 6 unsupported-field controls (ctrl-unsupp-001 to ctrl-unsupp-006) were independently verified via corpus-wide search across all 18,954 markdown files to be absent from the provider schema; 4 no-live-claim controls (ctrl-claim-001 to ctrl-claim-004) accurately reflect provider architectural limits (including commit snapshot provenance in ctrl-claim-001 and lack of provider functions in ctrl-claim-004 verified verbatim in documentation/provider/setup/index.md).

Model subset composition verified at 28 answerable, 8 ambiguous, and 4 controls, successfully testing HCL drafting (ans-deep-001, ans-deep-003, ans-deep-020, amb-001, amb-003, etc.), missing certificate values (amb-001), source commit provenance (ctrl-claim-001), supported fields, and exact leaf reads (ans-deep-001, ans-deep-003). Replaced synthetic ambiguous cases amb-002 and amb-038 in the subset with genuine architectural choices.

Natural user language and diversity confirmed: 97 of 140 answerable prompts and 10 of 40 ambiguous prompts omit the xcsh_ prefix in favor of everyday developer terminology; zero prompts use explicit dotted schema paths; all 140 answerable destinations are completely unique and uniquely identified by prompt context without hidden path clues or invented values.
limitations: Read-only independent inspection performed strictly on final-candidate.json, brief.md, source.json, and canonical documentation/ without inspecting retrieval code, executing retrieval, running Terraform, or querying external networks.

Verification evaluated semantic uniqueness, ambiguity validity, anchor existence, and schema depth against local authoritative Markdown files and xcsh_docs frontmatter metadata; runtime retrieval performance and scoring were out of scope.
